avoid: Best place to work / employer of choice

sectionOutline.ledeBrief: Walk a GP through morning → midday → afternoon rhythm: case mix, session length, documentation, handovers — paced general practice, not high-energy theatre.

blocks.heading: Open — arrive / list review
points: Arrive, review list, flag known recalls or results needing same-day attention
Brief check-in with nursing/reception on running late or complex bookings
Set documentation posture before first patient

blocks.heading: Core — mixed book
points: Acute presentations interleaved with reviews
Preventive care and mental health within ordinary GP time
Procedures only where credentialed and roomed
Session length reflects continuity work, not throughput maximisation

blocks.heading: Close — results, recalls, notes, handover
points: Results and correspondence triage
Recall actions and nurse handover where needed
Finish notes while context is fresh

blocks.heading: Media
points: Primary: day overview video or three-still timeline
Optional pull-quote from day-shape interview

blocks.heading: Honesty cue
points: Show paced general practice — avoid busy / high-energy framing
May not suit GPs seeking maximum throughput alone

sectionOutline.ledeBrief: How nurses protect consulting time: treatment room, preventive pathways, recalls, procedure support — clinical partnership, not ‘amazing nursing family’.

Immunisation, wound care, chronic-disease pathways
Recall and preventive work that does not need a full GP slot
Shared safety cues and escalation back to the GP

blocks.heading: Example handoff

Nurse prepares room / consent / equipment
GP joins for procedure or reviews outcome
Documentation and recall closed

blocks.heading: Media
points: Nurse–GP treatment still or 45–60s handoff vignette

blocks.heading: Honesty cue
points: Name roles and handoffs
Capacity depends on nursing cover for the session

Administrative forms and certificates process
